about:
AA Auto Parts operates from North Little Rock, Arkansas, where it has served as a salvage yard for late-model foreign vehicles since 1976. The business began with a focus on Toyota and Honda parts, building a reputation for southern hospitality and straightforward service.

The company stocks used, rebuilt, and new aftermarket components, adding new arrivals daily to an online inventory that customers can search by part number or vehicle. It offers a standard 90-day replacement warranty, with optional 6- and 12-month coverage, and provides same-day shipping on most common parts along with free local delivery. AA Auto Parts holds membership in the Automotive Recyclers Association and the Arkansas Automotive Dismantlers & Recyclers Association and carries the Locator Seal of Approval.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners and restoration enthusiasts to repair shops across the United States seeking cost-effective replacements for foreign makes. The company emphasizes its ability to source hard-to-find electrical components and parts for customized setups, positioning itself as a single source for keeping older imports on the road.

Founded on the principle that salvaging quality used parts is both economically and environmentally sound, AA Auto Parts differentiates itself through unflinching customer service, honest mileage disclosure, and a commitment to making the parts-finding process as simple as possible.
